Mixed together by hand (along with garlic salt, marjoram, black pepper, onion powder) and hand rolled the meat balls. Baked for about 30 minutes then broiled on high to get a nice almost char.

Put about four ounces of the raw meat/sausage mixture in the stock pot and let it cook. Added white & Portabella mushrooms that were simmered in butter. Let that cook together for about five minutes than drained the remaining grease and put back on low heat. Added four 16 oz. cans of tomato sauce and one small can of tomato paste, one can of cut up black olives, garlic salt, pepper, thyme, basil leaves, garlic and onion powder, oregano and parsley. Simmered about 30 minutes. Removed the basil leaves. Boiled a hand full of whole wheat spaghetti for 7 minutes and BAM - awesome meal!
